visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female character with black hair, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt, is seated at a white table in a brightly lit indoor environment. She faces the camera directly, looking professional yet approachable. Her hands are resting on the table initially, and some printed papers are visible in front of her. (2) She begins to gesture with her hands to emphasize her speech, holding up three fingers to indicate the number of options she is about to discuss. Her facial expressions are animated and match the flow of her conversation. (3) Small circular graphic overlays appear on the lower left of the screen, featuring a profile picture and the names 'Vera' or 'Becky'. Rectangular text overlays and bullet points also appear on the left side to highlight key terms like 'SIM卡' and '國際漫遊'. (4) The camera remains static at an eye-level medium shot throughout. She continues to use hand gestures, such as pointing to her palm or mimicking holding a phone, to illustrate the differences between physical SIM cards, eSIMs, and WiFi devices. The lighting is consistent, casting a soft glow on her face and the minimalist background.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: #日本旅遊初心者教學-網路篇. [Variety]: Q1.上網方式有哪些?. [Logo]: Vera. [Subtitle]: 基本上是三種. (2) [Subtitle]: 就是現在最常. (3) [Subtitle]: 大家會用的一個就是SIM卡. [Variety]: SIM卡. (4) [Subtitle]: SIM卡你就有分. [Variety]: SIM卡 (實體SIM卡、eSIM). (5) [Subtitle]: 實體的SIM卡. (6) [Subtitle]: 或是eSIM 虛擬的SIM卡. (7) [Subtitle]: 直接在手機裡面就可以加入的. (8) [Subtitle]: 另外一個是. [Variety]: 國際漫遊. (9) [Subtitle]: 直接開國際漫遊. (10) [Subtitle]: 你直接打電話給你的電信公司. (11) [Subtitle]: 跟他說你要去玩. (12) [Subtitle]: 他就會幫你開漫遊. (13) [Subtitle]: 基本上你什麼都不用做. (14) [Subtitle]: 第三種是租那個WiFi機. [Variety]: WIFI機. (15) [Subtitle]: 現在最流行的. (16) [Subtitle]: 就是這三種上網的方式. (17) [Subtitle]: 我們來分享一下. (18) [Subtitle]: 三種最常用的. (19) [Subtitle]: 上網方式的一些優缺點比較. (20) [Subtitle]: 比如像SIM卡或是eSIM. (21) [Subtitle]: SIM卡就是你要換實體卡. (22) [Subtitle]: 那eSIM的話它是直接掃一個QR code. (23) [Subtitle]: 或者是你直接下載. (24) [Subtitle]: 他就可以直接在手機裡面操作. (25) [Subtitle]: 所以這兩個比較之下. (26) [Subtitle]: 我覺得SIM卡比較麻煩. (27) [Subtitle]: 就是要記得把那個. (28) [Subtitle]: 手機卡片拿出來. (29) [Subtitle]: 最恐怖的是. [Logo]: Becky. (30) [Subtitle]: 你原本的那一張不見了. (31) [Subtitle]: 自己原本的那張門號的卡片. (32) [Subtitle]: 要保存好. (33) [Subtitle]: 一定要收好. (34) [Subtitle]: 所以其實大部分現在. (35) [Subtitle]: 都會希望是用eSIM. (36) [Subtitle]: 就是直接不用換卡. (37) [Subtitle]: 也不用拿出來這樣. (38) [Subtitle]: 那像國際漫遊的話. (39) [Subtitle]: 其實它也是非常方便. (40) [Subtitle]: 因為你什麼都不用做. (41) [Subtitle]: 就是電信公司幫你開了你就OK了. (42) [Subtitle]: 你就可以用. (43) [Subtitle]: 那它就是比較貴. (44) [Subtitle]: 就是單價是比較高的. (45) [Subtitle]: 另外一個是那個WiFi機. (46) [Subtitle]: 就是網路機的部分. (47) [Subtitle]: 年輕朋友們不要再用了吧. (48) [Subtitle]: 我們都帶小廢包出門了. (49) [Subtitle]: 然後還要再多帶一台. (50) [Subtitle]: 重點是誰要帶.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Introduction of 3 options -> Detailed comparison of SIM vs eSIM -> Pros/Cons of Roaming -> Critique of WiFi devices -> Closing
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate travelers planning a trip to Japan on the different internet connectivity options available. It provides a practical comparison between physical SIM cards, eSIMs, international roaming, and portable WiFi devices to help viewers choose the most suitable and convenient method for their needs.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a 'talking head' format combined with clear text overlays and subtitles, making it highly accessible for educational purposes on social media platforms.
